reason: README clearly indicates the plugin’s primary purpose is a DeepSeek Harness web interface add-on that adds a sidebar usage panel for account balance and token/cost usage monitoring, making the core category a navigation panel with data visualization.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端新增「用量」侧边栏入口与面板，供用户查看账户余额、会话用量统计与费用相关信息。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Usage entry and panel to the DeepSeek Harness web interface so users can view account balance, token usage, and related cost statistics.

capabilities: Displays account balance information in a web GUI panel
Reads and summarizes local session usage records by day, week, model, and session
Renders usage charts and token/composition views in a sidebar panel
Serves usage and period/billing-related data via host HTTP routes

reasons.code: The plugin is documented as a DeepSeek Harness web GUI usage panel that adds a sidebar "Usage / 用量" entry and provides live balance plus usage views.
It exposes balance and local usage endpoints (`/dsh-usage/balance`, `/dsh-usage/local`, `/dsh-usage/period`) and notes optional `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` configuration for balance retrieval.
